_comment: Sentry alert 1464000 (org myown-76, de.sentry.io), applied by the agent through the Sentry MCP (create_alert_rule / update_alert_rule). Errors (level error or worse): every save API error emails the owner, at most once per 30 min per issue, and opens a GitHub issue labelled incident through Sentry's GitHub integration (integration 558317, installed 2026-11-08): that issue wakes the on-call agent (.github/workflows/oncall.yml). Sentry opens one GitHub issue per Sentry issue. Warnings (level warning: only the 'new saves daily cap reached' message from server/index.js) email the owner and nothing else: the on-call agent fixes code from a stack trace, a warning has none, so waking it would only open a public incident issue it hands back to a human.
name: Save API error (a save or load failed): email owner, wake the on-call agent
